name: application-weather-widget
title: Weather Widget
description: Dashboard weather tile pairing a condition icon and current temperature with a forecast strip — hourly or 5-day, depending on the variant.
useWhen: Showing current conditions and an hourly or daily forecast on a dashboard or home screen.
You want a self-contained glanceable tile rather than a full weather page.
Pairing a bold gradient tile with other dashboard widgets that need visual variety.
avoidWhen: You need a full multi-day detailed forecast page — this is a compact glanceable tile only.
No real weather data source is available — a static placeholder tile can mislead users if left unconfigured.
The dashboard already has too many bold gradient tiles — use the bordered variant instead to reduce visual noise.
responsiveBehavior: The card has a fixed width suited to a dashboard grid cell; the forecast strip uses an even flex or grid split so it reflows if the card is narrowed.
accessibility: Every icon is decorative and marked aria-hidden — the adjacent visible text (temperature, condition, time/day label) is what conveys the information.
Temperature and condition text must meet WCAG AA contrast against the card's background, including on the gradient variant.
The current temperature and condition are stated in real text, not encoded only in an icon or color.

variants.title: Hourly forecast
variants.description: Bordered current-conditions tile with an hourly forecast strip beneath a divider.
accessibility: Each hourly entry pairs a visible time label and temperature with a decorative icon.

variants.title: Hourly forecast (Dark)
variants.description: Hourly-forecast weather tile adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Text and divider contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: 5-day forecast (gradient)
variants.description: Bold gradient-card tile with a 5-day forecast row, for a more prominent dashboard widget.
accessibility: White text on the gradient meets WCAG AA contrast against both gradient endpoints.

variants.title: 5-day forecast (gradient, Dark)
variants.description: Gradient 5-day forecast tile with a deeper gradient and a subtle ring for separation on a dark page.
accessibility: The ring provides a visible edge against a dark page background where a shadow alone would not be visible.
